The tank appears to be outdoors, placed on a dirt ground in front of a building with a metal gate.
There is visible wear, dirt, and some discoloration on the surface, especially near the bottom and around the base.
The tank has a black triangular logo with a stylized 'G' and the word 'GEEPEI' printed below it.
